title: Read unresolved Notion comments with AI
h1: collect unresolved comments from a notion page with ai
description: Ask AI to collect unresolved Notion comments from a specified page or block. Know why comments can go missing before you trust an empty list.
answer: a bot can retrieve unresolved comments attached to a notion page or block and turn them into a private review list. it needs the page or block and a notion connection that can see that page. this action only reads. it is not a history of resolved discussion, and one result page may not contain every unresolved comment you meant to review.
what:
point the bot at the place whose comments matter: a page for page discussion, or a particular block for comments on that block. paste the page link or name the page. for comments on a particular part, point it out and the bot finds it on the page.

the connection must be allowed to read that page's comments. a missing sharing grant can look like a not-found error, so have the bot report access problems rather than announce that nobody left feedback.
uses: collect open questions on a proposal before you send the next version
review comments attached to one disputed paragraph without searching every document
turn unresolved feedback into a list for the author to answer
check whether a named page still has discussion to resolve before a review call

routine.message: each thursday at 14:35, fetch unresolved page-level comments for the notion page cresswell pavilion proposal. check every page of comments, then list each question with its author here in dusk. say that comments on individual blocks are outside this check. never post a reply, resolve a discussion or rewrite the proposal.
routine.needs: notion connected with read only access, with the proposal page shared with the connection
routine.output:
cresswell pavilion proposal: unresolved page comments

- aislinn asks which entrance stays open during setup.
- mateusz requests the revised equipment list.

all returned pages checked. block-specific and resolved discussions not included. no replies posted.

steps: connect notion through **Connected apps** and keep the bot on **read only** for this feedback job.
make sure this page is one you let notion share with the connection when you signed in.
name the page or point to the part you want checked and ask for an initial read before scheduling the review.
check that the report names its scope, then use **Pause** on the routine card once the proposal review ends.
watch: the action returns unresolved comments, so it cannot stand in for a complete record of past discussion.
a page that isn't shared with the connection can look like it doesn't exist. that's an access problem, not a deleted page.
a long discussion comes back in parts; the bot should keep going until it has them all.
comments on the specified block or page are the scope; a page-level request should not claim every nested block was reviewed.

faq.q: can it reply to the reviewer as well?
faq.a: not with this action. fetching comments only reads them; posting a reply is a separate job with its own permissions.

faq.q: why can the bot read the page but not its comments?
faq.a: the notion connection may not be allowed to see that page's comments. ask it to show the retrieval error rather than treat the missing result as an empty discussion.
